### FairyRings

**Package:** `org.dreambot.api.methods.fairyring`  
**Type:** class  
**Hierarchy:** java.lang.Object → org.dreambot.api.methods.fairyring.FairyRings → org.dreambot.api.methods.fairyring.FairyRings  

**Methods:**
```java
static boolean codeEquals(String[] code);
static boolean enterCode(int slot, String letter);
static boolean enterTravelCode(String[] s);
static boolean enterTravelCode(FairyLocation fl);
static String getCode(int slot);
static String[] getCurrentCode();
static Rectangle getQuickTravelRect();
static boolean openTravelInterface();
static boolean quickTravel(String[] code);
static boolean quickTravel(FairyLocation fl);
static boolean quickTravelContains(String[] s);
static boolean quickTravelContains(FairyLocation fl);

static boolean travel(String[] code);
static boolean travel(FairyLocation location);
static boolean travelInterfaceOpen();
```

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `codeEquals(String[] code)` | Checks if the current code of the fairy ring equals the given code Ignores case |
| `enterCode(int slot, String letter)` | Enters a letter for a given slot First slot starts at 0 |
| `enterTravelCode(String[] s)` | See enterTravelCode(FairyLocation fl) |
| `enterTravelCode(FairyLocation fl)` | Enters the code for a given fairy location |
| `getCode(int slot)` | Gets the current letter of a given slot in the fairy code |
| `getCurrentCode()` | Gets the current fairy ring code as a String array |
| `getQuickTravelRect()` | Gets the Rectangle surrounding the quick travel widget container |
| `openTravelInterface()` | Opens the fairy ring travel interface, if a fairy ring is available and it is not already open |
| `quickTravel(String[] code)` | See quickTravel(FairyLocation fl) |
| `quickTravel(FairyLocation fl)` | Travels using the quick travel list on the fairy ring |
| `quickTravelContains(String[] s)` | See quickTravelContains(FairyLocation fl) |
| `quickTravelContains(FairyLocation fl)` | Checks if a fairy location is within your quick travel list |
| `rotateSlotClockwise(int slot)` | Rotates a slot clockwise once |
| `scrollToQuickTravel(String[] code)` | Scrolls to the quick travel widget with the given code |
| `travel(String[] code)` | See travel(FairyLocation fl) Except given the code as a String array (ignores upper/lower case) |
| `travel(FairyLocation location)` | Travels to a fairy location, if it exists in your quick travel list, it will use the quick travel otherwise it will enter the code and click travel. |
| `travelInterfaceOpen()` | Checks if the fairy ring travel interface is open |
